name: Vintage Camera Obscura Forest
description: Ancient trees grown into the shapes of massive vintage cameras — their hollow trunks are darkrooms, leaves are aperture blades, and each captures a different moment in the forest's history projected inside.
prompt: Ancient forest where massive trees have grown into shapes of vintage large-format cameras, hollow trunks serve as darkrooms with projected images on interior walls showing forest's history — seasons changing, creatures living, fires burning, regrowth, leaves function as aperture blades opening/closing, lens-like growths at front of each tree-trunk-camera, forest floor covered in developed photo-leaves, golden light beams through canopy, magical realism, hyperdetailed bark textures, 8k, mystical atmosphere
caption:
The forest photographs itself — every moment developed in chlorophyll and time. 📸🌳

Stand inside a memory. Watch the light write history.
